settings.question: When will Docked products be available?
settings.answer: Products remain Draft until supplier, safety, compliance, pricing, imagery, shipping, stock and payment checks are complete.

settings.question: Who are Docked aquatic products for?
settings.answer: Docked markets its aquatic range for adults aged 18 and over. Products are not life-saving devices or personal flotation devices and are intended only for the verified use environment stated on each product.

settings.question: Where can powered floats be used?
settings.answer: Unless approved documentation states otherwise, Docked powered floats are for calm, controlled swimming pools only - never oceans, rivers, lakes, moving water, waves or currents.

settings.question: How does Docked verify specifications?
settings.answer: Specifications and comparisons are published only from approved supplier documents, testing and compliance evidence. Unknown fields stay hidden.

settings.question: What does shipping cost?
settings.answer: Rates and eligible destinations will be shown at Shopify checkout only after carrier and dangerous-goods requirements are configured and tested. Docked does not claim free shipping before it is confirmed.

settings.question: How do returns work?
settings.answer: Contact support@docked.com.au before returning anything. Change-of-mind conditions are separate from rights and remedies under the Australian Consumer Law.

settings.question: Do Australian Consumer Law guarantees apply?
settings.answer: Yes. Our goods come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law. Product warranty terms do not replace those rights.

settings.question: How can I contact Docked?
settings.answer: Email support@docked.com.au. The Heidelberg Heights address is for correspondence and authorised returns only; there is no public showroom or walk-in service. Mailbox operation must be verified before launch.
